labctl.notes: no exec channel: drive via QMP keys and read the framebuffer. Pointer is ABSOLUTE via the kh-ramabs control object on <dir>/ptr.sock (labctl mctl): the commanded pixel is written into CTMOUSE's own coordinate and published with one 1-unit PS/2 nudge. SINGLE INJECTOR - while that socket is connected nothing else may push motion or button edges at this mouse. disk.qcow2 is the ONLY block device and carries the 'golden' vmstate (FreeDOS FAT16 + C:\ENSEMBLE), baked under /opt/qemu-beos -- never delete or replace it; recapture only via checkpoint-guard, and re-derive KH_RAMABS_ADDR after.

render.stationsManifestPrelude:
# pcgeos (VMID 175) — PC/GEOS Ensemble (GeoWorks lineage, bluewaysw Apache-2.0 build) on FreeDOS 1.3.
#   VERBATIM LAUNCHER: disk.qcow2 (FreeDOS FAT16 + C:\ENSEMBLE, copied from the
#   builder output on first launch) is the ONLY block device and holds the savevm
#   'golden' vmstate. -vga std VESA 800x600 16-bit (vga16.geo), sb16 + PC speaker
#   -> dbus audiodev, absolute pointer via kh-ramabs (CTMOUSE coordinate).

launcherParity.reason: freedos device set with -vga std (VESA 800x600 for vga16.geo), the station's own disk, and the kh-ramabs control object (no vmstate, no emulated hardware) under the /opt/qemu-beos build

pointerRamAddress.derivedAgainstGolden: 2026-09-03 01:21 cold bake under /opt/qemu-beos without truetype.geo (VM_CLOCK 0000:00:42.439, VM_SIZE 3.47 MiB, tag `golden` in disk.qcow2)
pointerRamAddress.note: Guest-physical address of CTMOUSE's own pointer coordinate (int16 x, int16 y, little-endian) -- the input kh-ramabs writes; GEOS's mouse driver (the zip's default [mouse] entry) takes the absolute CX/DX from CTMOUSE's INT 33h callback, so the guest republishes it after one 1-unit nudge. Valid ONLY for the golden named in derivedAgainstGolden (loadvm restores RAM verbatim). Re-derive after every re-bake with scripts/dev/pcgeos-ramabs-derive.py (four-position pmemsave bias search over the first 1 MB, then the device's own connect-time write probe per candidate, ~3 minutes). The search returned six (0,0)-bias addresses on each of two bakes (0x76e0 0x76e4 0x931e 0x936a and two GEOS-side copies); exactly one verified both times — CTMOUSE loads before GEOS, so its data segment did not move. Five MOVEA targets incl. (20,560) and (780,30) landed pixel-exact in the framebuffer, hotspot (0,0).

museum.lineage: GeoWorks Ensemble → NewDeal Office → Breadbox Ensemble → PC/GEOS (open source 2018)
museum.arch: i386 (runs on a 286 in 640 KB), on FreeDOS 1.3
museum.blurb: GeoWorks Ensemble: a preemptive-multitasking, object-oriented graphical desktop that ran in 640 KB on a 286 — the 1990 GUI that made Windows 3.0 look slow, kept alive as open-source PC/GEOS.
museum.notes: Live streamhost station. FreeDOS 1.3 boots straight into loader.exe; the whole desktop (Motif Redux look, taskbar, 800x600 VESA) is drawn by GEOS itself. Absolute pointer: the daemon writes the visitor's pixel straight into CTMOUSE's own coordinate (kh-ramabs) and GEOS's generic INT 33h driver picks it up, so the cursor maps 1:1. disk.qcow2 is the single block device and carries the golden vmstate, so a reset restores the FAT filesystem too.
